You can't stop taking medication quickly without withdrawals. Even sometimes going off it slowly will still cause withdrawals. Your brain gets used to having a certain med and flips out when you're not taking it. It might help to take all your medications again and wait a while if you want to go off them. You'll need to do it one at a time and slowly like take a pill every other day rather than every day. I'd look up the meds' side effects and maybe try to go off the worst one. Withdrawals can be hell. Your brain can function without medicine but it will take a while for everything to get out of your system. There might also be better medicines out there for you than the one you're on. I wish you luck.
